entries.rule: After creating a new project or agent, open its owning VS Code workspace and the new agent definition or draft preview before reporting completion. Verify the opening; surface a blocked opening step rather than silently skipping it.
entries.exception: If the user explicitly requests upgrading Project Orchestrator itself to include the new projects, agents, files, or other framework artifacts, keep that work in the Project Orchestrator workspace.

source.evidence: User required every newly created project or agent to be opened, with an explicit Project Orchestrator upgrade as the exception.

boundaries: Current instructions and verified repository evidence outrank this memory.
Opening does not authorize installation, deployment, publication, external mutation, commits, or pushes.
The governed workflow uses the existing create-project --open option; low-level CLI defaults are unchanged.
Opening a separate VS Code window does not transfer the current chat to that workspace.

changes.rationale: Persist the user's creation follow-through requirement and preserve the explicit framework-upgrade exception.
